services.desc: A vintage Miami shuffleboard club with a splash of tropical flair and a whole lot of party energy. The Royal Palms Shuffleboard Club is an 18,000 square foot tropical oasis keeping Brooklyn on vacation all year long. By completing the form, you’ll also be added to our email list for future party tips and tropical treats. Having trouble with the form? Email your party details to party@royalpalmsbrooklyn.com and we’ll get you set up. Royal Palms is a 21+ shuffleboard club, but offers Family Days on specified Sundays. More information
